title: 第5章 为了抓我特意搞个神像来？
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: 备注名很简洁，只有三个标签，精准概括了对方在叶凛眼里的全部价值。还没等他从记忆库里检索出这位“好心人”的真身，那扇饱经风霜的防盗门就遭到了毁灭性打击。咚！咚！咚！这动静，不像敲门，像拆迁队上门强制执行。墙皮簌簌往下掉，落在叶凛刚换好的拖鞋上。“叶凛！开门！我知道你在家！别装死！”声音清亮，穿透力极强。叶凛叹了口气，这声音化成灰他都认得。除了住在对门的那个“人形暴龙”夏晚晴，没人能把敲门这种日常动作搞得像特警突袭。他刚把锁舌弹开，门板就被一股蛮力从外面撞开。一个人影裹挟着热浪冲了进来。“出大事了老叶！天塌了！”来人一头利落的栗色齐耳短发，发梢挂着细密的汗珠。她的皮肤是那种常年户外运动晒出来的健康小麦色。五官英气逼人，如果不看那双清澈得有些过分的杏眼。单看这咋咋呼呼的架势，很容易让人把她当成邻居家刚放学的傻小子。夏晚晴穿着一件宽松的白色T恤，下摆随意打了个结，露出紧致的马甲线。至于那原本应该彰显女性特征的部位……只能说，聊胜于无。反正靠着板上钉钉能勉强分清正反面就够了。这是叶凛的青梅竹马，也是个孤儿。两人从小在同一个老旧小区吃百家饭长大，属于那种我有吃的给你你一口，你有吃的给我我一口的铁杆关系。只不过，这丫头从小就长歪了。明明是个女孩子，却有着一身使不完的牛劲，性格更是豪爽得像梁山好汉。在叶凛的认知里，她除了身份证上的性别是女，其他地方跟“女的”这两个字基本不沾边。她一把抓住叶凛的肩膀，力道大得像是要把他的骨头捏碎。“你还有心思睡觉？外面都乱成一锅粥了！”夏晚晴眼睛亮得像两个探照灯，兴奋得手舞足蹈：“神话复苏了！真的复苏了！”叶凛不动声色地把肩膀从她的魔爪下解救出来。“哦，复苏了。”他转身走到破旧的沙发旁坐下，拿起桌上的凉白开灌了一口：“所以呢？房东说下个月房租能免吗？”“你怎么这么淡定！”夏晚晴恨铁不成钢地凑过来，一屁股坐在他对面。“就在刚才！欧罗巴地区那边降临了一座超级巨大的神像！据说是什么火神赫菲斯托斯！”“还有人当场念出了祂的名字和事迹，直接获得了超能力！”“手搓火球啊大哥！比打火机牛逼多了！”叶凛握着水杯的手微微一顿。赫菲斯托斯？不会这么巧吧？“手搓火球？”叶凛撇撇嘴，语气里带着几分嫌弃。“那确实比打火机强点，至少省了买气的钱。”要是让夏晚晴知道，那个所谓的“火神”刚才差点一锤子把他敲成肉泥，不知道这丫头还会不会这么兴奋。“不仅仅是国外！”夏晚晴完全没听出他的敷衍，越说越激动，甚至站起来比划了一个夸张的手势。“就在市中心广场！也出现了一座赫菲斯托斯的分身神像！”“虽然没有国外那个大，但已经发光了！”“好多人都去参拜了！听说只要神力亲和度高，就能成为信徒，以后就是人上人了！”“老叶，咱们也去吧！万一咱俩有个天才呢？”“到时候我罩着你！”看着她那副跃跃欲试的样子，叶凛心里有点想笑，又有点无奈。这就是夏晚晴。明明自已过得也不咋地，兜里比脸还干净，却总想着罩着他。小时候有人欺负叶凛，这丫头能拎着半块砖头追人家三条街。后来叶凛没钱交学费，她偷偷去打黑工，把攒下来的钱塞给他，说是“捡的”。虽然她神经大条，虽然她是个平胸，虽然她有时候吵得让人想把她嘴缝上。但在这个世界里，她是唯一一个会让叶凛划进“自已人”圈子里的傻子。“不去。”叶凛拒绝得干脆利落。“咱俩纯纯社会底层，你就记住一句话。”“当你闻到蛋糕的香味时，有些人已经吃撑了。”“你现在去，除了能领两斤汽车尾气，什么都捞不着，还容易发生踩踏事故等等各种危险。”“所以，等着就好。”“只要这种东西没有次数限制，大人物们为了立爱国爱民人设肯定会让你舔一口的。”而且，去拜赫菲斯托斯？叶凛怕自已刚一露头就被秒了。“不去拉倒！”夏晚晴气鼓鼓地瞪着他，也不客气。她熟练地从茶几底下摸出一双属于她的拖鞋换上，然后大摇大摆地走向厨房。“你不去我去！但我现在饿了，先吃饱了再说。”“哎？你煮了饺子？”厨房里传来碗筷碰撞的声音。紧接着这丫头端着叶凛刚煮好的一盘饺子走了出来，毫不客气地坐在沙发上开吃。“真香！还是你煮的饺子好吃，外面的全是科技与狠活。”夏晚晴塞得腮帮子鼓鼓的，像只囤食的仓鼠，完全没有要走的意思。叶凛也没赶她，反正这丫头蹭饭也不是一天两天了。他重新拿起手机，点开了那个未读消息。手指上滑，聊天记录像瀑布一样展现在眼前。刚才被夏晚晴一打岔，差点忘了这茬。【170，42D，爱穿黑丝】手指上滑，聊天记录像瀑布一样展现在眼前。【转账：200元（备注：自愿赠与，买双像样的鞋。）】【转账：500元（备注：自愿赠与，这钱拿去买羽绒服，别冻着。）】【转账：100元（备注：生日快乐）】【已退回】【转账：200元（备注：自愿赠与，生日快乐）】……看着这些橙澄澄的转账记录，叶凛原本有些模糊的记忆瞬间清晰起来。哦，想起来了。秦菲菲。学校的校花，家里做建材生意，典型的暴发户二代。之前这女人不知抽了什么风，非要追他。叶凛本来是拒绝的。但架不住对方在转账备注里写了“自愿赠与”。作为一个有原则的穷人，叶凛觉得自已不能看不起任何人。于是他含泪收下了这笔“扶贫款”，并把对方当成了单纯的ATM机。“你看啥呢？笑得这么猥琐。”夏晚晴一边嚼着饺子，一边凑过脑袋来偷看。叶凛也没躲，直接点开了那条最新的长语音，还很贴心地开了免提。“叶凛，我们结束了。”秦菲菲的声音从听筒里传出来，带着一股高高在上的优越感。“我知道这很突然，但现实就是这么残酷。”“就在刚才，我在王少的安排下接触了神像，神力亲和度高达85%。”“85%是什么概念你应该不懂，简单来说，我是注定要成为超凡者的人。”夏晚晴嘴里的饺子差点喷出来。她瞪大了眼睛，一脸看智障的表情看着手机：“这女的谁啊？”语音还在继续。“王家的大少爷已经向我发出了邀请……”“帅不能当饭吃，活好也不能……”“以后别再联系我了……”最后是一张照片。照片里，秦菲菲穿着晚礼服，依偎在一个满脸油光的胖子身边，那胖子的手正不安分地搂着她的腰。“噗——咳咳咳！”夏晚晴终于没忍住，被饺子皮呛到了。她指着照片上的胖子，笑得直拍大腿：“这就是她说的‘王少’？”“这体型，不知道的还以为是哪家养猪场的种猪成精了呢！”“她是不是瞎啊？放着你这么个大帅哥不要，去跟一头猪谈恋爱？”虽然夏晚晴平时总损叶凛，但在颜值这一块，她是无脑站叶凛的。叶凛抽了张纸巾递给她，慢条斯理地打字。“人家那是为了前途。”“前途？我看是‘钱途’吧！”夏晚晴翻了个白眼。“85%亲和度很牛吗？我看她那样子，顶多也就是个当炮灰的料。”叶凛笑了笑，没说话。他手指飞快地在屏幕上敲击。【叶凛：已读。】【叶凛：不过分手这事……我什么时候同意你表白了？】
content_en: The remark name is very concise, with only three labels, which accurately summarizes the entire value of the other party in Ye Lin's eyes.Before he could retrieve the true identity of this "good Samaritan" from his memory bank, the weather-beaten security door suffered a devastating blow.Boom!Boom!Boom!This movement is not like knocking on the door, but like the demolition team coming to enforce the law.The wall covering fell down and fell on the slippers that Ye Lin had just changed."Ye Lin! Open the door! I know you are at home! Don't pretend to be dead!" The voice was clear and penetrating.Ye Lin sighed, and he recognized the sound of turning into ashes.Except for Xia Wanqing, the "humanoid tyrannosaurus" who lives across the door, no one can make the daily action of knocking on the door look like a SWAT raid.As soon as he flicked the lock bolt open, the door panel was knocked open from the outside by a brute force.A figure rushed in carrying a heat wave."Something big happened, Old Ye! The sky is falling!" The person who came had neat chestnut-colored short ear-length hair, with fine beads of sweat hanging from the ends of his hair.Her skin is the kind of healthy wheat color that comes from years of outdoor exercise.Her facial features are so handsome, if you don't look at her pair of almond-shaped eyes that are a little too clear.Just by looking at her bluffing posture, it is easy for people to think of her as a silly boy from the neighbor's house who just got out of school.Xia Wanqing was wearing a loose white T-shirt, with the hem knotted casually, revealing her tight waistcoat line.As for the parts that were supposed to highlight female characteristics... I can only say that they are better than nothing.Anyway, it's enough to be able to distinguish the front and back by relying on the nail on the board.This is Ye Lin's childhood sweetheart and an orphan.The two of them grew up eating Baijia rice in the same old neighborhood. They have a hard-core relationship where I give you a bite of what I have to eat, and you give me a bite of what I have to eat.However, this girl has grown crookedly since she was a child.She is obviously a girl, but she has endless energy and a bold personality like a Liangshan hero.In Ye Lin's perception, except for the gender on her ID card, which is female, the word "female" basically has nothing to do with her elsewhere.She grabbed Ye Lin's shoulders with such force that she felt like she was going to crush his bones."You still want to sleep? It's a mess outside!" Xia Wanqing's eyes were as bright as two searchlights, and she was dancing with excitement: "The myth has come back to life! It's really come to life!" Ye Lin calmly freed his shoulders from her clutches."Oh, I'm recovering." He turned around and walked to the shabby sofa and sat down. He picked up the cold drink on the table and took a sip: "So? The landlord said that next month's rent can be waived?" "Why are you so calm!" Xia Wanqing came over and sat down opposite him."Just now! A huge statue of a god descended over the Europa region! It is said to be the God of Fire Hephaestus!" "Some people read out his name and deeds on the spot, and directly gained superpowers!" "Brother, rub the fireball with your hands! Much more awesome than a lighter!" Ye Lin paused slightly while holding the water glass.Hephaestus?It can't be such a coincidence, right?"Rubbing fireballs with your hands?" Ye Lin curled his lips, with a hint of disgust in his tone."That's indeed better than a lighter. At least it saves money on gas." If Xia Wanqing knew that the so-called "Vulcan" almost knocked him into a pulp with a hammer just now, I wonder if this girl would be so excited."Not just abroad!" Xia Wanqing didn't hear his perfunctory tone at all. She became more and more excited as she spoke, and even stood up and made an exaggerated gesture."It's right in the city center square! There is also a clone statue of Hephaestus!" "Although it is not as big as the one abroad, it is already shining!" "Many people have gone to worship! I heard that as long as you have a high affinity with the divine power, you can become a believer, and you will be a master in the future!" "Old Ye, let's go too! What if we two have a genius?" "I will protect you then!" Seeing her eagerness to try, Ye Lin felt a little want to laugh, but also a little helpless.This is Xia Wanqing.Even though she was not doing well, her pocket was cleaner than her face, yet she always wanted to protect him.When Ye Lin was a child, someone bullied her. This girl could chase him down three streets while carrying half a brick.Later, Ye Lin had no money to pay for school fees, so she secretly went to work illegally and gave him the money she saved, saying she "picked it up."Although she is very nervous, even though she is flat-chested, even though she is sometimes so noisy that people want to sew her mouth shut.But in this world, she is the only fool who would let Ye Lin enter the circle of "his own people"."No." Ye Lin refused simply."We are both at the bottom of society, just remember one thing." "When you smell the aroma of cake, some people are already full." "If you go now, you can get nothing except two pounds of car exhaust, and you are also prone to stampede accidents and other dangers." "So, just wait." "As long as there is no limit on the number of times for this kind of thing, the big shots will definitely let you lick it in order to establish patriotism and love the people." And, go to Beihe Festus?Ye Lin was afraid that he would be killed as soon as he showed his head."Don't pull him down!" Xia Wanqing glared at him angrily, not polite.She deftly took out a pair of slippers that belonged to her from under the coffee table, put them on, and walked to the kitchen with a swagger."If you don't go, I will! But I'm hungry now. I'll eat until I'm full first." "Huh? Did you cook the dumplings?" The sound of clinking bowls and chopsticks came from the kitchen.Immediately afterwards, the girl came out with a plate of dumplings that Ye Lin had just cooked, and sat down on the sofa to eat without ceremony."It's so delicious! The dumplings you cook are delicious. Everything outside is full of technology and hard work." Xia Wanqing's cheeks were bulging, like a hamster hoarding food, with no intention of leaving.Ye Lin didn't chase her away. Anyway, this girl didn't have to eat for a day or two.He picked up the phone again and clicked on the unread message.Swipe up with your finger, and the chat history appears before your eyes like a waterfall.I almost forgot about this when I was interrupted by Xia Wanqing just now.[170, 42D, loves to wear black stockings] Sliding your finger upward, the chat history is displayed before your eyes like a waterfall.[Transfer: 200 yuan (note: voluntary gift, buy a pair of decent shoes.)] [Transfer: 500 yuan (note: voluntary gift, use this money to buy a down jacket, don't freeze it.)] [Transfer: 100 yuan (note: happy birthday)] [Returned] [Transfer: 200 yuan (note: voluntary gift, happy birthday)]... Looking at these orange transfer records, Ye Lin's originally vague memory suddenly became clear.Oh, I remembered it.Qin Feifei.The school beauty, her family runs a building materials business, a typical second generation of nouveau riche.This woman didn't know what had happened before, and she had to chase him.Ye Lin originally refused.But the other party couldn't resist and wrote "voluntary gift" in the transfer notes.As a principled poor man, Ye Lin felt that he could not look down on anyone.So he tearfully accepted the "poverty alleviation money" and regarded the other party as a simple ATM machine."What are you looking at? You're smiling so obscenely." Xia Wanqing leaned over to take a peek while chewing the dumplings.Ye Lin didn't hide, he clicked on the latest long voice message and turned on the speakerphone very considerately."Ye Lin, we're done." Qin Feifei's voice came from the receiver, with a sense of superiority."I know this is sudden, but the reality is so cruel." "Just now, under the arrangement of Mr. Wang, I came into contact with the divine statue, and the divine affinity is as high as 85%." "You probably don't understand the concept of 85%. To put it simply, I am destined to become a transcendent." The dumplings in Xia Wanqing's mouth almost spit out.Her eyes widened and she looked at the phone with a retarded expression: "Who is this woman?" The voice continued."The eldest young master of the Wang family has already sent me an invitation..." "You can't make a living by being handsome, and you can't live a good life..." "Don't contact me again..." The last thing is a photo.In the photo, Qin Feifei was wearing an evening dress, nestling next to a fat man with a shiny face, and the fat man's hands were restlessly holding her waist."Pfft - cough cough cough!" Xia Wanqing finally couldn't hold it back and choked on the dumpling wrapper.She pointed at the fat man in the photo and smiled so hard that she slapped her thighs: "Is this the 'Young Master Wang' she was talking about?" "With this body shape, I would have thought it was a breeding pig from a pig farm that became sperm!" "Is she blind? Why don't you, a handsome guy like you, fall in love with a pig?" Although Xia Wanqing usually always disgraces Ye Lin, but in terms of appearance, she has no brains to stand up to Ye Lin.Ye Lin took out a tissue and handed it to her, typing slowly."It's for the future." "Future? I think it's a 'money path'!" Xia Wanqing rolled her eyes."Is 85% affinity very good? I think she is just cannon fodder at best." Ye Lin smiled and said nothing.His fingers were tapping rapidly on the screen.[Ye Lin: Read.】【Ye Lin: But about breaking up...when did I agree to your confession?】
